notationLegend.meaning: Instant air teleport; follow the demonstrated airborne timing
Yoga Teleport / Yoga Float; follow each reference's movement and timing notes
Denjin Renki. Each reference states when a stored charge is required.
Tatsumaki Senpukyaku / its airborne version; strength and timing follow the reference.
Shoryuken; L, M, H and OD identify the demonstrated version.
High Blade Kick (Jodan Sokutogeri). These names refer to the same special move.
Hashogeki. Denjin versions require a stored charge when stated in the reference.
Tatsumaki Zanku-kyaku; strength and timing follow the reference.
Gou Shoryuken; L, M, H and OD identify the demonstrated version.
Gou Hadoken / Zanku Hadoken. Charged versions are identified in the reference.
Adamant Flame is Akuma's quarter-circle-back punch special. A ~ marks a follow-up action; use the listed button and timing.
Demon Raid (Hyakkishu). Each reference identifies the demonstrated follow-up or landing action.
Conditions state any required medal level. Match that starting state before practising.
Manon's command throw, distinct from the Renversé hit grab. Use the listed strength.
Renversé, the striking special that leads into its throw. Follow the reference's version and execution cues.
Rond-point; L, M, H and OD identify the demonstrated version.
Dégagé; follow the strength and spacing stated in each reference.
Serenity Stream. Entering the stance and pressing a follow-up button are separate actions; follow the listed continuation or exit.
Down-forward heavy punch, Chun-Li’s overhead. This is distinct from SS.HP, the heavy-punch follow-up from Serenity Stream.
Spinning Bird Kick. Brackets such as [2] mean hold that direction before completing the input. Follow each reference’s charge or stance execution cue.
Hundred Lightning Kicks / Aerial Hundred Lightning Kicks. Use the listed strength and grounded or airborne version.
Tensho Kicks, distinct from Spinning Bird Kick. Use the listed strength.
Yosokyaku, the airborne down-medium-kick stomp. Follow the demonstrated jump direction and number of stomps.
Chun-Li’s projectile. Follow the strength and charge or stance execution cue stated in the reference.
Brackets mean hold the direction before completing the input. [4] is back charge; [2] is down charge. Follow each reference’s charge and release cues.
Guile’s charged projectile. Use the listed strength and any Perfect execution cue stated in the reference.
These names refer to the same down-charge kick. Use the listed strength and preserve charge during the preceding actions.
Sonic Blade places a stationary projectile. Sonic Cross is the projectile continuation after Blade; follow the listed strength, input and timing.
Solid Puncher is Guile’s Level 2 Super Art. Sonic Break actions during it are separate follow-ups; match the listed buttons and timing.
Back heavy punch can appear as a separate link or as the medium-punch target follow-up. Match the reference’s timing cue; these are different routes.
Down-forward heavy kick (3HK) and crouching heavy punch (2HP) are different attacks. Match the listed standing or crouching opponent condition.
Heavy-punch and medium-punch Sonic Hurricane. Use the listed punch version; a launcher and its juggle continuation are not interchangeable.
